model.title: SAFE Drugs Act of 2026
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Jim Banks (R-IN)

summary.text: The bill would increase oversight of pharmacies that mix customized medications by allowing them to compound drugs that are essentially copies of commercially available products up to 20 times per month (compared to the current limit of 4 times per month) and would require certain large-scale compounding facilities and out-of-state operations to undergo regular inspections and submit annual reports to federal regulators.
